Coachella 2026 Weekend 1 (April 10–12) is headlined by Sabrina Carpenter (Friday), Justin Bieber (Saturday), and Karol G (Sunday) at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, CA. The 25th-anniversary lineup features a major electronic focus, including Anyma, Jack White, The Strokes, and FKA Twigs. Weekend 1 Headliners & Top Acts Friday, April 10: Sabrina Carpenter (9:05 PM, Coachella Stage), Anyma, The xx, Disclosure, Teddy Swims, Sexyy Red, KATSEYE, Ethel Cain, Turnstile, Blood Orange, Devo. Saturday, April 11: Justin Bieber (11:25 PM, Coachella Stage), The Strokes, Jack White (3 PM, Mojave), Labrinth, PinkPantheress, Addison Rae, Giveon, Interpol, David Byrne, Nine Inch Noize. Sunday, April 12: Karol G (9:55 PM, Coachella Stage), FKA Twigs, Young Thug, Little Simz, Major Lazer, Foster the People, Iggy Pop, Fatboy Slim, Kaskade, Clipse, Wet Leg. Key Details Surprise Sets: Jack White plays a 3 PM set on Saturday in the Mojave Tent. Highlights: Anyma presents the world premiere of Æden; The Bunker debuts a 75-minute Radiohead Kid A Mnesia exhibition. Streaming: 7 stages will be streamed on YouTube, with 4K coverage for the main three stages. Tickets: The festival is sold out, but verified resale passes may be found on the official Coachella website. official Coachella website
